$comment: Reviewed vulnerability-audit exceptions for BUILD TOOLING only (CI gate 12).
1. The advisory must NOT appear in `pnpm audit --prod`. The production
scope has no exception path and fails regardless of this file.
2. Every entry needs an expiry date. An unpatched advisory is a decision
to revisit, not a fact to file away — an expired entry fails the build
so someone has to look again.
3. Fixing it is always preferable. An override in pnpm-workspace.yaml is
usually enough; lowering --audit-level is never acceptable, because it
silently disables the gate for everything else too.

exceptions.justification: Denial of service via infinite loops in the ICNS, JXL and HEIF parsers. NO patched version exists. Reached only through @nx/webpack -> less, a webpack path TEKAD does not use: builds go through @angular/build (esbuild) per ADR-012 and Spike B. The parser is invoked only when a stylesheet references an image for size inlining, which no TEKAD build does. Dev-only; ships nothing. Re-check for a patched release, and re-check whether @nx/angular still drags @nx/webpack in.
